I guess the chronology for TP might be structured in as many ways as there are different ways of thinking. An obvious structure would be along the lines of the tv series' development.

Another structure might be built from the pov of agent Cooper. Or from the pov of agent Rosenfield followed up by his protege agent Preston. I particularly like the thought of building the combo povs of deputy chief Hawk and the log lady. We should allow that each character holds some of the jigsaw pieces, but not all.

I do wonder if chronologies must inevitably lead to the bigger picture of the grand scheme of things. TPTR (2017) certainly did that and it was both flabbergasting and exhilarating. The exhilaration came to a climax when agent Cooper declared that "I am the FBI" as the original score of TP began playing. Some viewers were moved to tears, others yelled "Yes!".
